result.finding: Java Maven project with 8 runtime/compile dependencies and 3 test-scoped dependencies declared in pom.xml. All runtime dependencies are bundled into the Spring Boot fat JAR during the Docker build stage.
evidence: Dockerfile build stage: COPY pom.xml . then RUN mvn dependency:go-offline -B (downloads all deps)
Dockerfile build stage: COPY src ./src then RUN mvn clean package -DskipTests (builds fat JAR)
pom.xml declares 11 total dependencies (8 runtime/compile, 3 test-scoped)
Spring Boot fat JAR bundles all runtime deps — no runtime mvn/pip/npm install in final container
Final container image: only the fat JAR is copied (no build tools, no dependency manager)
values: Runtime/compile dependencies (8): spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, ojdbc8, spring-boot-starter-validation, commons-io:2.11.0, spring-boot-starter-json, spring-boot-devtools (optional)
Test-scoped dependencies (3): spring-boot-starter-test, h2, (JUnit 5 via spring-boot-starter-test)
Parent BOM: spring-boot-starter-parent:2.7.18 manages transitive dependency versions
